summary: A freed slot's pick takes the live pickable and claimed sets but hands its entry's TickContext the wave's opening prior-attempts map — half the facts, one world out of date
acceptance: every fact a refill-pulled entry's `TickContext` carries is the one the selection that pulled it was taken over — the prior-attempts map beside `pickable` and `claimed` — so a `shouldRun` or `promptArgs` on a refilled slot reads the records as they stand at that moment rather than as the wave opened, and no site warrants a single read on records this wave's own merges rewrite
tests: a refill-pulled entry's TickContext names a prior-attempt record written earlier in the same wave
notes: Verified this tick: `refillRead` (`src/waveTick.ts:468`) reads `leg.attempts.readAll()` for the re-selection and drops it, while `:474`/`:475` publish the other two facts; `runSlot` closes over the opening read (`:103`) and passes it at `:405` into `ctx.priorAttempts` (`:757`). `waveMerge.ts:734`, `:861`, `:975` write and clear records mid-wave, so `:99`'s warrant — the records do not change mid-wave — is false. The NP-A no-commit case (`tests/Dispatcher.test.ts`) is the reachable shape.
